# FG-REPO-0012

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`repository-provisioning`](../../ops/runbooks/repository-provisioning.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_repository_stuck_in_provisioning_is_reported_by_doctor` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: リポジトリの準備が終わっていません。問い合わせ番号を添えて管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The repository is not ready yet. Contact the administrator with the request ID.
- id: Repositori belum siap. Hubungi administrator dengan menyertakan ID permintaan.

## 原因 (cause)

A repository has stayed in state `provisioning` (forge.repositories, step D4) for longer than 10 minutes, or its provisioning job (`repository.provision`, dedup key `repository_provision:<repo_id>`) is no longer queued or running: it is dead (a permanent failure such as FG-REPO-0004 `adopt_refused`, or its attempts were used up), missing, or it succeeded without the repository being marked ready. The job normally creates the bare directory (`init_bare_or_adopt`) and marks the repository ready within seconds; until then the project exists but cannot be cloned or pushed.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Reported by `forge doctor` (check `repositories.provisioning`) with `reason` of the first stuck repository (`job_not_live`: no queued or running provisioning job; `too_old`: the job is still live but the repository waits longer than the threshold), `stuck` and the counts per reason `job_not_live` / `too_old` (the 10 000 oldest provisioning repositories are classified; `truncated` when there are more), and the first one's `repo_id`, `project_id`, `age_ms`, `job_state` and `threshold_ms`. `job_not_live` repositories are listed before `too_old` ones, each oldest first. The job is the end of the repository's key chain: `repository_provision:<repo_id>`, then `repository_provision:<repo_id>:after:<job id>` for each reprovision behind a succeeded job. `job_state` is that job's state: `queued`, `running`, `succeeded` (it succeeded but the repository is not ready: a database restore or a manual change; the doctor line says so in `detail`) or `none` (dead or missing). Look up the jobs with a privileged query on forge.jobs (kind `repository.provision`, dedup_key `repository_provision:<repo_id>` or `repository_provision:<repo_id>:after:%`, newest first): `last_error_code` / `last_error` say why one died; the worker log has `forge.repo.provisioned` for each success and the job failure (FG-DB-0006) with the same origin request id. `too_old` with a queued job usually means no `forge worker` runs (doctor `outbox.sequencer_lag` says whether one was observed).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow the runbook: fix the cause the job reported (storage root permissions or space for FG-REPO-0003, a directory at the path for FG-REPO-0004: inspect it, never delete it blindly), make sure a `forge worker` runs, then run `forge admin repo reprovision <repo_id>` (an approved runbook step): it enqueues the job again after a dead or missing job, and after a succeeded one under the key `repository_provision:<repo_id>:after:<job id>`; it changes nothing while a job is queued or running.
